value.rationale: The already-known nonequivariant sphere-wedge homotopy classification leaves full integral automorphism action undetermined. The new closed G- and wreath-product module determines all character values at every threshold, while the r=2 coinvariants reveal a sharp nontrivial two-torsion boundary invisible over Q. This is a natural complete symmetry refinement for the same graph family, not an arbitrary finite slice.
